_note: SCAFFOLD. NPC / unit-type catalog (not named companions). Worker units and generic android assistants. Named companion personas stay in companions/. All game-only; never sold for real money.

units.description: Universal android assistant worker unit — black metallic humanoid with gold filigree, magenta seam glow, crowned double-headed eagle chest crest. Printed: SCDI | OMNI-WORKER - UNIVERSAL ANDROID ASSISTANT. Suit series card 14. Catalogued as an NPC worker unit type (not a new named companion); batch_01 companion omni_worker is the spawnable template.
units.notes: SCDI suit series card 14. Worker unit / NPC type — do not register a second named companion. Links existing companions/omni_worker/.
